description: This file defines the EcuInit interface, which declares methods for retrieving ECU identifier and initialization bytes in the RomRaider ECU communication module.

classes.name: EcuInit
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for ECU initialization data retrieval.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the ECU identifier as a String.

methods.name: getEcuInitBytes
methods.description: Returns the ECU initialization data as a byte array.
